repo.description:
### Impact

The `docker-options` plugin allows any user with app-level dokku access to store arbitrary strings as Docker options. These strings are later concatenated into the `DOCKER_ARGS` shell variable and expanded via Bash eval without any sanitization. Because `eval` performs command substitution, an user with remote ssh access to executing `docker-options` commands  can inject `$(...)` or backtick expressions that execute arbitrary commands on the host as the dokku user during `build`, `deploy`, or `run` operations.

### Patches

- #8848
repo.summary: Host Command Execution via eval of Unsanitized Docker Options in DOCKER_ARGS
